text_block_list.text:
Looks like we can still get some training 
in today. Since the opportunity presented 
itself, I called out to the students on 
the track—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Me, me! I wanna do parallel running 
training! Since Kaicho is here, we just 
have to run together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm feeling in great shape today! So 
without missing this chance, I'd like to 
explore running technique to the absolute 
limit!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Physical training is fine, but how 
about this? Making friends through 
reading—gathering around books and 
elevating each other's knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I heard that new technical manuals have 
just arrived in the library.

Every proposal is appealing, but if we're 
doing extra training together...
choice_data_list:
Let's deepen our knowledge of running 
through reading.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's settled then. Everyone, let us change 
clothes so as not to catch a chill before 
gathering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us immerse ourselves in study and 
elevate one another.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you really get it~! Running 
all together is way more fun anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's decided—hurry, hurry! Even 
against Kaicho, I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I never know when my health might 
decline, so opportunities like this are 
super precious!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Today I'll go all the way—*cough*, *hack*! 
Excuse me! While keeping an eye on my 
health, all the way! I want to train!
